items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: And that's been so long ago, Gene.

ctx.x: I want to take two more things. What was Bakay's name? Do you remember? There was more than one of them here, I know.
And that's been so long ago, Gene.
Could it have been Ashiel or George or something like that? Could have been...
